answer: Time-locked contribution ledger: identities earn standing only by completing verifiable work before being counted. Each new identity must first submit a solo contribution that a blind reviewer confirms; rejection leaves a hollow record and forces a cooldown. An attacker paying for N identities must fund N genuine work-units, each verifiable on-chain and attested at summit review. A fable of cheap mass registration collapses: cost scales with real labor, not money.
